_comment_top: Image-prompt template. Compose by filling in the references and per-render fields, then submit to image-gen tool. Schema follows the 2026 industry-standard formula: Identity + Core Traits + Clothing/Style + Pose + Lighting/Camera + Background. Identity and Core Traits are frozen across renders for consistency; Pose, Lighting, Camera, Background vary per render.
_comment_references: References point at character/scene/product entries by slug. The renderer (today: operator + agent; future: rich-media-studio CLI) hydrates these into full descriptive blocks before submission.

references.character_slug: REPLACE — character slug, or null if no character in this image
references.scene_slug: REPLACE — scene slug, or null if abstract/studio

identity._comment: Hydrated from character.identity_block. FROZEN across all renders of the same character.

clothing_style._comment: Pick a wardrobe variant by id, or override.

pose._comment: Per-render. What the character is doing in this single frame.
pose.description: REPLACE — e.g. 'standing at kitchen counter, hands on coffee mug, looking down with slight smile'

camera.lens_or_focal_length: REPLACE — e.g. '50mm equivalent, shallow depth of field'
camera.framing_notes: REPLACE — composition cues (rule of thirds, negative space, etc.)

lighting._comment: Hydrated from scene.lighting by default; override fields per-render only when needed.

background._comment: Hydrated from scene.environment by default; per-render override for specific elements.

product_in_frame._comment: When a product slug is referenced. Defines how the product appears in this specific render.

style_modifiers._comment: Brand-canon style modifiers; per IMAGE_STYLE.md. These are appended to the prompt.
style_modifiers.aesthetic: REPLACE — e.g. 'photorealistic, soft natural light, slight film grain' or 'illustrative, flat colors with neon-green accents'
negative_modifiers: no on-screen text in image (text is added in post)
no fabricated UI elements not in product entry

honesty_flags._comment: Carried into the publish-log entry for the artifact this render is part of.

render_provenance._comment: Filled in by the renderer at compose time so renders are reproducible.
